headline: Terrestrial Energy Appoints Senior Industry Executive Pamela Cowan as EVP of Engineering
summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., July 30, 2026--Terrestrial Energy Inc. (Nasdaq: IMSR), a developer of proprietary Generation IV small modular nuclear power plants, today announced the addition of Pamela Cowan as EVP of Engineering, effective immediately. She will be based at the Charlotte, N.C. headquarters and report to Terrestrial Energy CEO Simon Irish.

headline: AEP Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Earnings, Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) today reported second-quarter 2026 GAAP earnings of $713 million or $1.31 per share, compared with GAAP earnings of $1,226 million or $2.29 per share in second-quarter 2025. Operating earnings for second-quarter 2026 were $742 million or $1.36 per share, compared with operating earnings of $766 million or $1.43 per share in second-quarter 2025. See the detailed GAAP to operating earnings reconciliation at the end of this press release.
